stopReason: Section 8 requires all four Stage H gates to PASS before Stage A2 may begin. True mobile touch fails on the product: the page declares no touch-action, so the browser claims the gesture and cancels the pointer stream after one move. Fixing it is a product interaction change, which both Stage H and Stage A2 forbid, so it needs an explicit decision.
